        (fun y => ((qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)

      intro x hx
      have hfg : f x ≠ g x := by

        simp only [Y, fiberwiseDisagreementSet]
        exact ⟨x, rfl, hfg⟩
      apply Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr

      simp only [coe_univ, Set.image_univ, Set.toFinset_range, mem_image, mem_univ,
        true_and]
      use pointToIterateQuotientIndex (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
        (h_i_add_steps := by omega) (x := x)
      exact (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps (by omega)

d_i : ℕ := BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨↑i, ⋯⟩
d_next : ℕ := BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨↑i + steps, ⋯⟩
h_d_i_pos : 0 < d_i
hC : Nonempty ↥C_i
g : ↥(sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨↑⟨↑i, ⋯⟩, ⋯⟩) → L
hg : g ∈ C_i
hmin : d_fw = (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g).ncard
hdist : ↑Δ₀(f, g) ≤ ↑d_fw * 2 ^ steps
hbridge : d_H ≤ ↑d_fw * 2 ^ steps
hfw : 2 * d_fw ≤ d_next - 1
hid : (d_next - 1) * 2 ^ steps = d_i - 1
hfinite : d_H ≠ ⊤
d_H_nat : ℕ := d_H.toNat
hdH : Δ₀(f, ↑C_i) = ↑Δ₀(f, ↑C_i).toNat
hfinal : 2 * d_H_nat ≤ d_i - 1
⊢ 2 * Δ₀(f, ↑C_i).toNat < BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨↑i, ⋯⟩
